correctness.rationale: At fixed 0<ε<1 an active edge contributes ε(p_i+p_j)/(4m) to the degree-weighted mass drift, regardless of the orientation of its disagreement. Every copying rate on a discordant edge is strictly positive; a spanning-tree sequence to consensus and the finiteness of the state space give a finite mean absorption time. Stopping the bounded degree mass gives the stated occupation correction, and the fixation probability is harmonic. Testing singleton plus sets shows that a nonzero same-preference drift cannot cancel there. For arbitrary signed linear weights, the singleton plus and singleton minus equations add to the unbiased walk equation for r_i=w_i/d_i: r_i is the average of its neighbors. The connected-graph maximum principle forces a constant r_i, without a positivity assumption. Thus an arbitrary nonzero linear martingale is exactly a multiple of M and exists only under edgewise cancellation. The star degrees put half of the mass at the hub; independent rate-one clocks have total first-change hazard (r+1)(1−ε)/2. Independent replay: python3 -B /workspace/branches/independent_checks.py 1, 644 exact generator-rank tests on all connected labeled simple graphs of orders 2–4 at ε=2/5, checking the dimension and degree basis of the linear martingale space. The analytic argument, not the finite tests, establishes the general statement.
